decision.reason: The repository's recovered native APK root is independently identified as Marrow. Cerebellum's verified decompiler/source evidence exists in the Library but its native source tree is not materialized in the Cerebillum repository.
safe_next_step: Materialize the verified Cerebellum decompiler/source tree or exact APK into the Cerebellum workspace.
Verify package, MainActivity, manifest, assets/index.android.bundle and resource ownership from that materialized artifact.
Create the rebuildable Android/React-Native host only from that Cerebellum evidence.
Stage the already-validated Cerebellum PYQ HTML only into the verified Cerebellum asset/content layer.
Build and runtime-test before claiming APK integration.

contamination_guards: Never use reconstruction/apk_root as Cerebellum host.
Never copy Marrow DEX/resources/assets/media/lib into Cerebellum.
Never use cross-source question repetition as subject ownership evidence.
Never fabricate Gradle files, Activities, Manifest entries, package IDs or native architecture.
